Title: Psyche! / Illusions of the Kindred question

Messages.Author: Andrew Hartsell
Messages.Body:
This came up in a game the other night, and we couldn't come up with an
answer that everyone agreed on, so we just ended up dropping it. What
happens if two vampires enter combat, one plays 'Illusions of the Kindred'
(which ends combat), then the other vampire plays 'Psyche!' (starting combat
again)?

Thanks

-ru

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <JH1z2.49$n15...@newsfeed.slurp.net>,


Illusions of Kindred [AH] - Combat (chi) (2)

* Illusions of Kindred can be played when your crypt is empty. In this
case, it simply ends combat. The rest of the effect is lost, since no
new opponent can be retrieved from the crypt. [LSJ 971002]
* There is no room to play Psyche (superior) between the time Illusions
of Kindred ends combat and when the new combat begins. So, unless your
crypt is empty when you play Illusions of Kindred, Psyche cannot be
played. [LSJ 971002]
